# Travel Style API
Server latency, requests, errors, model version, and uncertainty. Client latency is reported separately.

Charts combine the main and staging apps. Server errors are HTTP 5xx; expected 422 responses are not server errors. Latency is measured inside the app, not over client HTTPS. Logs may arrive late. Only observed time bins are shown. The original tables below retain model version and failure details.

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where ContainerAppName_s in ('travel-style-492ea24d', 'failure-492ea24d') | extend j=parse_json(Log_s) | where isnotempty(j.path) | summarize Requests=count(), ServerErrors=countif(toint(j.status)>=500) by bin(TimeGenerated,1m) | order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Requests and server errors per minute

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where ContainerAppName_s in ('travel-style-492ea24d', 'failure-492ea24d') | extend j=parse_json(Log_s) | where isnotempty(j.path) | summarize MeanMs=avg(todouble(j.duration_ms)), P95Ms=percentile(todouble(j.duration_ms),95) by bin(TimeGenerated,1m) | order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Application latency (ms): mean and p95

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where ContainerAppName_s in ('travel-style-492ea24d', 'failure-492ea24d') | extend j=parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(j.event)=='prediction_batch' | summarize Predictions=sum(toint(j.count)), Uncertain=sum(toint(j.uncertain_count)) by bin(TimeGenerated,1m) | order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Predictions and uncertain profiles per minute

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where ContainerAppName_s in ('travel-style-492ea24d', 'failure-492ea24d') | extend j=parse_json(Log_s) | where isnotempty(j.path) | summarize Requests=count(), Errors=countif(toint(j.status)>=500), MeanMs=avg(todouble(j.duration_ms)), P95Ms=percentile(todouble(j.duration_ms),95) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), Model=tostring(j.model_version)
content.title: requests

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where ContainerAppName_s in ('travel-style-492ea24d', 'failure-492ea24d') | extend j=parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(j.event)=='prediction_batch' | summarize Predictions=sum(toint(j.count)), Uncertain=sum(toint(j.uncertain_count)) by bin(TimeGenerated,1m)
content.title: profiles

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where ContainerAppName_s in ('travel-style-492ea24d', 'failure-492ea24d') | where Log_s contains 'semantic_canary_failed'
content.title: failure
